name: claude-mem
description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
one_liner: Gives your AI coding assistant a memory that survives between sessions, so it doesn't forget what you were working on and why every time you close the chat.
buyer: An indie developer or small dev team lead working on a long-running codebase with AI assistants who is tired of re-explaining project context every new session.
business_use_cases: A solo developer installs it so their coding assistant remembers past architectural decisions and in-progress refactors across weeks, cutting repeated re-explaining.
A small team standardizes on it so every engineer's agent sessions share compressed project memory, keeping agents consistent across different people's chats.
A technical writer or consultant uses it to keep an AI assistant's memory of a client's codebase intact between billable sessions.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted 'Pro' memory tier (already referenced in the README as 'CMEM Pro') with better compression/retrieval for teams who don't want to self-host.
Charge for integration support getting this wired into a company's specific multi-agent and multi-tool setup.

steal_this: It already ships a hosted Pro tier, so there isn't much left to build around the core tool itself — the real weekend move is just installing it on your own coding setup and writing up the before/after as content to attract consulting clients.
